Output is sum over positions i of binomial(n-i+2,3)*p(x_i).","source":"def investigate(context, acquire):
    values = context["values"]
    n = len(values)
    total = 0
    for i in range(n):
        x = values[i]
        p = 2 * x * x * x - 2 * x * x
        w = (n - i + 2) * (n - i + 1) * (n - i) // 6
        total = total + w * p
    return total
